description: ITR foreign-asset schedule template + tax slab config. Edit via the Tax Config tab or directly in this file.
notes: foreignAssetTemplate: default key-values merged into each row of the generated ITR JSON. Per-share fields (InterestAcquiringDate, InitialValOfInvstmnt, PeakBalanceDuringPeriod, ClosingBalance) are computed from holdings data.
slabs: evaluated top-to-bottom; first matching holdingPeriodMinYears wins.
holdingPeriodMinYears: minimum years held for this slab to apply.
taxPercent: flat rate applied to capital gain (value today − cost basis).
